name: cua-driver
description: Desktop control through the OpenAgent Cua Driver daemon.

en.description: Desktop control through the OpenAgent Cua Driver daemon.
en.notice.pluginData: PLUGIN_DATA is not set, so this launcher has nowhere to keep the driver it downloads. The OpenAgent host exports it as the package's own writable directory; set it to a writable empty directory to run this package outside OpenAgent, or set OPENAGENT_CUA_DRIVER_BIN to a Cua Driver already on this machine.
en.notice.unsupportedPlatform: Cua Driver publishes no pinned release for {platform}. Pinned platforms: {supported}. Set OPENAGENT_CUA_DRIVER_BIN to a driver built for this machine to run one anyway.
en.notice.pinnedTable: The pinned table has no entry for '{platform}'. Pinned platforms: {supported}. Set OPENAGENT_CUA_DRIVER_BIN to a driver built for this machine to run one anyway.
en.notice.archiveType: The pin for '{platform}' names '{asset}', which is not a supported archive
en.notice.provisionFailed: Cua Driver {version} could not be provisioned for {platform}. Check network access and the plugin data directory; the download is {url} and its cache directory is {release}.
en.notice.installFailed: Cua Driver {version} could not be installed under {release}. Stop any other OpenAgent process using this driver, then retry.
en.notice.declaredLimit: the download declares {size} bytes, beyond the accepted limit
en.notice.returnedLimit: the download returned {size} bytes, beyond the accepted limit
en.notice.digestMismatch: the asset digest is {actual}, not the pinned {expected}, so the release has changed under this package's pin and nothing was installed
en.notice.startFailed: Unable to start Cua Driver ({code}) from {source}; check the driver installation and platform support
en.notice.archiveInvalid: The downloaded archive is invalid; verify the pinned release and retry

zh.description: 通过 OpenAgent Cua Driver 守护进程控制桌面。
zh.notice.pluginData: 未设置 PLUGIN_DATA，启动器没有位置保存下载的驱动。OpenAgent 主机会将它设为插件专用的可写目录；若要在 OpenAgent 外运行，请将其设为可写的空目录，或将 OPENAGENT_CUA_DRIVER_BIN 设为本机已有的 Cua Driver 路径。
zh.notice.unsupportedPlatform: Cua Driver 没有为 {platform} 提供固定版本。支持的平台：{supported}。若要在此设备运行，请将 OPENAGENT_CUA_DRIVER_BIN 指向为本机编译的驱动。
zh.notice.pinnedTable: 固定版本表中没有平台“{platform}”的条目。支持的平台：{supported}。若要在此设备运行，请将 OPENAGENT_CUA_DRIVER_BIN 指向为本机编译的驱动。
zh.notice.archiveType: 平台“{platform}”的固定版本指定了“{asset}”，但它不是支持的压缩包格式
zh.notice.provisionFailed: 无法为 {platform} 准备 Cua Driver {version}。请检查网络连接和插件数据目录；下载地址为 {url}，缓存目录为 {release}。
zh.notice.installFailed: 无法将 Cua Driver {version} 安装到 {release}。请停止正在使用此驱动的其他 OpenAgent 进程，然后重试。
zh.notice.declaredLimit: 下载声明的大小为 {size} 字节，超过允许上限
zh.notice.returnedLimit: 下载返回的大小为 {size} 字节，超过允许上限
zh.notice.digestMismatch: 文件摘要为 {actual}，与固定摘要 {expected} 不符；发布文件可能已变更，未安装任何文件
zh.notice.fetching: 正在从 {url} 下载适用于 {platform} 的 Cua Driver {version}
zh.notice.startFailed: 无法从 {source} 启动 Cua Driver（{code}）；请检查驱动安装和平台支持情况
zh.notice.archiveInvalid: 下载的压缩包无效；请检查固定版本的发布文件后重试
